tool: Moudel AI consolidated authorized security screening
scope: Automated, non-destructive screening only. Not a full OWASP Top 10 audit, penetration test, or certification.
limitations: No automated scanner can prove absence of vulnerabilities.
IDOR test requires two isolated test accounts and user-owned resource paths.
SQLi/XSS checks are low-impact indicators, not exploit validation.
Load test measures only the selected endpoint and does not establish maximum concurrent users.
CSRF, SSRF, stored XSS, business-logic flaws, dependency scanning, secret-history scanning and full RLS testing require separate validation.

findings.title: Missing CSP
findings.recommendation: Define a CSP matching the deployed frontend; begin in Report-Only mode.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.recommendation: Set a restrictive Referrer-Policy, e.g. strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.recommendation: Disable browser features the application does not use.

findings.title: Server technology disclosure
findings.recommendation: Remove unnecessary framework/version disclosure where practical.

findings.title: No rate limit observed in gentle probe
findings.detail: 15 sequential requests did not receive HTTP 429; this does not prove rate limiting is absent.
findings.recommendation: Verify configured limits independently, especially login, reset, search and expensive routes.
